rules.deletion: all three annual deltas >= near_score, all block CI lower bounds > 0, all metric/diagnostic/monthly guards pass
rules.retention: all three annual deltas <= -near_score, all block CI upper bounds < 0; direct conditional evidence only
rules.uncertain: incomplete direct evidence, near score, conflicting annual signs, CI spans zero, metric/diagnostic/monthly risk, or differing background conclusions
rules.joint_pass: no negative annual deletion delta, no clear annual degradation, all metric/diagnostic/monthly guards pass; joint evidence cannot establish individual necessity

bootstrap.trigger: every comparison, including all near/conflicting cases; descriptive intervals without multiplicity or post-selection significance claims
bootstrap.turnover_boundary: sample paired contiguous noncircular date blocks; exclude each block first-day turnover including original incoming transition; never construct turnover across resampled seams; retain original internal adjacent-day transitions
bootstrap.scope: fixed trained predictions within one year; conditional sampling uncertainty, not retraining or cross-year evidence
